subject: math
attribution: Practice items adapted from Virginia Department of Education released SOL tests.

questions.stem: Ralph’s map of Virginia Beach uses a scale of 1 inch for every 7 miles. Ralph runs a distance of 13.2 miles from his house in Virginia Beach every weekend. Which is closest to the number of inches needed to represent this distance on Ralph’s map?

Max surveyed students on his website and asked each student to select one favorite after-school activity. The results were recorded as percentages of all responses as follows: Watching movies: 56% Roller skating: 6% Listening to music: 12% Shopping: 10% Basketball: 9% Reading: 4% Playing games: 3% If 126 students selected watching movies, how many total students responded to Max’s survey?
A jug of drinking water contained 15 gallons. After one day, 2⅝ gallons had been used. How much water was left in the jug?
Kevin mixes paint using 8 ounces of yellow paint for every 3 ounces of white paint. At this rate, how many ounces of white paint would be mixed with 24 ounces of yellow paint?
Lynne loaned $480 to a friend. The friend paid back the amount borrowed plus 10% interest. What was the total amount the friend paid to Lynne?
Eli can type 1 page in 10 minutes. How many total pages can he type in one hour?

The change in the number of students enrolled at a school over six months is shown below: October: −15 students November: +12 students December: −8 students January: +5 students February: −10 students March: +14 students The number of students enrolled at the end of September was 4,327. What was the number of students enrolled at the end of March?
Which set is ordered from greatest to least?
Which property is used in the number sentence 4(3 + n) = (4 × 3) + (4 × n)?
Which of the following is another way of expressing 2 out of 8?
Which list is in order from least to greatest?
The fraction 1/8 is equivalent to which percent?
Which of the following equations illustrates the multiplicative property of zero?
Which statement is false?
Which ordered pair describes a point located in the second quadrant of a coordinate grid?
Five triangles are given with side lengths labeled. Based on proportional side lengths, which pair of triangles is most likely similar?

Travis is making a wall hanging out of different colors of glass. The shape is drawn on a coordinate grid where each square represents 1 square unit. The shape covers approximately 36 unit squares. Which is closest to the total amount of glass needed to make the wall hanging?
A figure on a coordinate grid has a vertex V at (5, −2). The figure is translated vertically 6 units in the positive direction. Which best describes the location of the image of vertex V?
Which of the following figures has exactly five sides?
A figure on a coordinate grid is moved so that every point is the same distance from the origin as before, but the orientation changes. Which type of transformation most likely took place?
The following is true about similar triangles ABC and DEF: AB/DE = BC/EF = AC/DF = 2/1 Which could be the lengths of BC and EF?

Trevor covered a cylindrical can with paper. The can is 18 centimeters tall and has a radius of 5 centimeters. Which is closest to the minimum amount of paper needed to cover the entire can, including the top and bottom?
Which of the following quadrilaterals has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
A polygon has 7 sides. What type of polygon is it?

A powdered drink mix is stored in a cylindrical container with a radius of 6 centimeters and a height of 14 centimeters. Which is closest to the maximum number of cubic centimeters the container will hold?

Bob wants to paint a rectangular wall that measures 16 feet by 9 feet. The wall contains a rectangular window that measures 4 feet by 5 feet. If Bob does not paint the window, what is the total area he will paint?

Peter picks one bill at a time from a bag and replaces it. He repeats this process 100 times and records the results: $1 bill: 28 times $5 bill: 14 times $10 bill: 56 times $20 bill: 2 times Based on the data, which bill has an experimental probability of 1/5 of being drawn next?
The number of kites sold each year during a school fundraiser is listed in a table. When the data are ordered, the middle value is 680. What is the median number of kites sold per year?
At Van’s Video Store, 30% of the children’s movies are animated. If one children’s movie is chosen at random, what is the probability it will be animated?
Tim wants his mean quiz score to be 90. His first three scores were 86, 92, and 94. What score must he earn on the fourth quiz to have an average of exactly 90?

Three families each have three members: Guevara family: Mariah, Stephen, Joseph Jackson family: Sean, Zachary, Mary Farris family: Hannah, Erin, Edward How many different teams of three can be formed with one member from each family?
A school club recorded weekly attendance as follows: 12, 9, 20, 15, 13, 8, 16, 12, 18, 10, 26, 14, 24, 17, 18 Which statement is best supported by the data?
A box-and-whisker plot of video rentals shows a minimum of 10, a lower quartile of 35, a median of 60, an upper quartile of 65, and a maximum of 90. What is the lower quartile?
The rosebushes in Pattie’s Plant Store are 20% yellow, 50% red, and 30% pink. If George selects one rosebush at random, what is the probability it will produce yellow blooms?
A box-and-whisker plot of dinner prices shows a minimum of $15 and a maximum of $65. What is the range of the prices?
Which scatterplot best represents no significant relationship between people’s heights and the amount of money they spend on food each week?
Jackie may choose from 3 shirts, 2 pairs of pants, and 3 pairs of shoes. How many different outfits consisting of 1 shirt, 1 pair of pants, and 1 pair of shoes can she make?

Which phrase best represents the expression 5/n + 7?
